manifest.source: Kimi Code 0.34.0 controlled print-mode census plus a digest-pinned projection of the exact release source. The source inventory contains 40 persisted and 8 transient operation types; unforced branches remain unverified.

argv.notes: Native Kimi process launch and KIMI_CODE_HOME selection.

terminal.notes: Native TUI presentation and guarded input; terminal text is not semantic truth.

hook-command.notes: Configured external hooks receive one JSON document on stdin.

claims.harness: isolated KIMI_CODE_HOME with loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, command hooks, multi-invocation resume, detached process task, provider rejection, hook block/deny, HTTP retry, print-mode SIGINT abort, and a foreground subagent journal
SHA-256, file identity, --version, --help, rejected-option, and raw-capture tree probes

claims.notes: Digest-pinned exact release source establishes 40 persisted operation schemas, 8 transient types, 20 hook schemas, protocol 1.5, and CLI declarations; it does not promote unforced runtime behavior.

limitations: The controlled census is native print mode, including multi-invocation resume, a detached process task, provider rejection, hook block/deny, HTTP retry, print-mode SIGINT abort, and a foreground subagent journal; it is not interactive PTY mode.
Runtime evidence covers 26 of 63 modelled surfaces; the remaining 37 are exact-source-only.
Interactive TUI permissions, questions, steer, queueing, Esc-cancel with durable turn.ended(cancelled), compaction, swarm, and non-success process-task outcomes remain unverified.
Only the locally installed darwin-arm64 artifact has runtime evidence; this is not a support promotion.
